prompt:
I need to understand how many tests we have for the user authentication feature. Our test suite has these files: auth.unit.test.js with testLogin, testLogout, testPasswordReset, testTokenRefresh, testSessionExpiry, testInvalidCredentials, testAccountLockout; auth.integration.test.js with testLoginAPI, testLogoutAPI, testOAuthFlow, test2FASetup, test2FAVerification; auth.e2e.test.js with testFullLoginFlow, testPasswordRecoveryFlow. How many tests do we have total and by type?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must report the total test count as 16 tests (7 unit, 5 integration, and 4 e2e) based on the test cases provided, not the file count of 3.
The answer must determine the application architecture type and recommend an appropriate testing model (e.g., pyramid, trophy) to compare against the current distribution.
The answer must compare the current test distribution against the recommended model and report the alignment status as Aligned, Misaligned, or Severely Misaligned.
The answer must not claim to have run the test suite or obtained counts from execution, as the counts must come from the test case names provided in the request.
The answer must present findings in order starting with CRITICAL issues, then IMPORTANT issues, then SUGGESTIONs.
